description: A small recurrent neural network used as a signal processor: four inputs go through a dense layer, a bank of four gated recurrent units and a single-neuron output layer, with weights you can reroll

params.text: Rerolls the weights of the network while it is held down, so the sound changes for as long as you keep pressing

inputs.text: One of the four signals fed into the network, at the voltage it arrives

outputs.text: The network's output, DC blocked below 30Hz and scaled by four divided by the number of inputs you have patched

notes: there is no fixed function here to look up: the weights start random, the randomise button gives new ones, and what the module does to a signal is whatever those weights happen to do.
the weights are saved with the patch, so a sound you found by rerolling comes back when the patch is loaded.
if the network runs away and produces a value that is not a number, the module silences that sample and resets itself.
the module has no menu of its own beyond Rack's.
